title: GTA 6 Black Friday 2026: Live Deals on Controllers, Storage and the Game
desc: GTA 6 Black Friday 2026 deals, checked November 20: the PS5 DualSense and the Pulse Elite headset are on sale (see today's prices), the GTA 6 Edition controller isn't discounted, GTA 6 itself isn't on sale in the US yet, and what to buy for the 212 GB install.
lede: Amazon's Black Friday Week is already on: it runs November 19 to 30 (Black Friday is November 27, Cyber Monday November 30). Here's what's actually on sale for GTA 6 players right now, checked against deal reports from Tom's Guide, GamesRadar and others. Prices change fast, so check the price on the store page before you buy.
sections:
Live deals (checked Nov 20, 10 AM ET)

  • PS5 DualSense controller: on sale (see today's price) at Amazon and PlayStation Direct, reported on sale by several deal sites (Kotaku, Gizmodo). The best GTA 6 buy this week: one controller charges while you play. See it on Amazon
  • PlayStation Pulse Elite headset: on sale (see today's price), reported by TechRadar and Shattered. Good if you play GTA 6 late at night. See it on Amazon
  • GTA 6 Edition DualSense: not discounted. It isn't part of Sony's sale. Buy it for the look, not the price. Check stock
  • GTA 6 itself: no US discount yet. Deal trackers found it at full price ($79.99) at US stores; new games rarely drop in launch week. If you see it cheaper, check the console and edition.
  • 2 TB PS5 SSD: the big early deal (a 2 TB heatsink SSD for about $300 at Best Buy) ended on November 15. Watch for it to come back on Black Friday; in the meantime, try the free space fixes. Current 2 TB SSD prices

Affiliate links: as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, at no extra cost to you. Prices are what deal sites reported on Nov 19 and can change at any time.
GTA 6 is up to 212 GB. A 2 TB PS5 SSD with a heatsink or an Xbox storage expansion card are the upgrades that actually fix "storage full". Try the free fixes first.

New releases rarely get big Black Friday discounts in launch week. If you see GTA 6 cheaper, check it's the right console and edition.
How to spot a real deal

• Check the price history, not just the "was" price.
  • For PS5 SSDs: M.2 NVMe, PCIe Gen4, with a heatsink.
  • For Xbox: only official expansion cards play Series X|S games.
  • Avoid sellers with no reviews.

The standard PS5 DualSense, on sale and, if your console is full, a 2 TB PS5 SSD with a heatsink when it drops in price again.
